EMPTY_CONTENT.subject: CONTENT
EMPTY_CONTENT.rule: The content is present and not blank.

SIZE_EXCEEDED.subject: CONTENT
SIZE_EXCEEDED.rule: The canonical content, and each section note, stays within its byte limit.

MALFORMED_JSON.subject: JSON
MALFORMED_JSON.rule: The content parses as JSON, its root is an object, and it reserializes.

UNKNOWN_FIELD.subject: FIELD
UNKNOWN_FIELD.rule: Every key of every object in the content is one its schema declares.

MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD.subject: FIELD
MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD.rule: Every key its schema requires is present, at every level of the content.

INVALID_FIELD_TYPE.subject: FIELD
INVALID_FIELD_TYPE.rule: A present value, at any level of the content, has the kind its field declares: the JSON kind, a non-empty value that matches its id format or holds a non-space character, and an integer within the safe integer range.

INVALID_CATEGORY.subject: CATEGORY
INVALID_CATEGORY.rule: The category is a Mirror Dungeon category.

MISMATCHED_CATEGORY.subject: CATEGORY
MISMATCHED_CATEGORY.rule: The category is valid for the planner type.

UNKNOWN_VERSION.subject: VERSION
UNKNOWN_VERSION.rule: Season game data exists for the content version.

MISSING_TITLE.subject: TITLE
MISSING_TITLE.rule: A published planner has a non-blank title.

UNKNOWN_KEYWORD.subject: KEYWORD
UNKNOWN_KEYWORD.rule: Every selected keyword of a published planner is a planner keyword.

UNKNOWN_IDENTITY.subject: IDENTITY
UNKNOWN_IDENTITY.rule: The identity id exists in the game data.

MISMATCHED_IDENTITY.subject: IDENTITY
MISMATCHED_IDENTITY.rule: The identity belongs to the sinner it is equipped on.

OUT_OF_RANGE_IDENTITY_LEVEL.subject: IDENTITY
OUT_OF_RANGE_IDENTITY_LEVEL.rule: The identity level is within the game's level bounds.

OUT_OF_RANGE_IDENTITY_UPTIE.subject: IDENTITY
OUT_OF_RANGE_IDENTITY_UPTIE.rule: The identity uptie is within the game's uptie bounds.

UNKNOWN_EGO.subject: EGO
UNKNOWN_EGO.rule: The E.G.O id exists in the game data.

MISMATCHED_EGO.subject: EGO
MISMATCHED_EGO.rule: The E.G.O belongs to the sinner it is equipped on.

OUT_OF_RANGE_EGO_THREADSPIN.subject: EGO
OUT_OF_RANGE_EGO_THREADSPIN.rule: The threadspin is within the game's bounds and at most that E.G.O's ceiling.

MISSING_EGO_THREADSPIN_CEILING.subject: EGO
MISSING_EGO_THREADSPIN_CEILING.rule: A known E.G.O has a threadspin ceiling in the game data.

EXCESS_DEPLOYMENT.subject: DEPLOYMENT
EXCESS_DEPLOYMENT.rule: The deployment order holds at most 12 entries.

OUT_OF_RANGE_DEPLOYMENT.subject: DEPLOYMENT
OUT_OF_RANGE_DEPLOYMENT.rule: Every deployment order entry is a sinner index between 0 and 11.

DUPLICATE_DEPLOYMENT.subject: DEPLOYMENT
DUPLICATE_DEPLOYMENT.rule: No sinner repeats in the deployment order.

OUT_OF_RANGE_SKILL_TOTAL.subject: SKILL
OUT_OF_RANGE_SKILL_TOTAL.rule: A sinner's skill slot values add up to 6.

DUPLICATE_EGOGIFT.subject: EGOGIFT
DUPLICATE_EGOGIFT.rule: No E.G.O gift repeats within an observation, comprehensive or floor gift list.

UNKNOWN_EGOGIFT.subject: EGOGIFT
UNKNOWN_EGOGIFT.rule: Every start, observation and comprehensive E.G.O gift id exists in the game data.

EXCESS_STARTBUFF.subject: STARTBUFF
EXCESS_STARTBUFF.rule: At most as many start buffs are selected as the season has distinct base ids (id modulo 100).

UNKNOWN_STARTBUFF.subject: STARTBUFF
UNKNOWN_STARTBUFF.rule: The start buff id exists for the season.

DUPLICATE_STARTBUFF.subject: STARTBUFF
DUPLICATE_STARTBUFF.rule: No two selected start buffs share a base id.

MISSING_STARTGIFT_KEYWORD.subject: STARTGIFT
MISSING_STARTGIFT_KEYWORD.rule: Selected start gifts have a start gift keyword.

UNKNOWN_STARTGIFT_KEYWORD.subject: STARTGIFT
UNKNOWN_STARTGIFT_KEYWORD.rule: The start gift keyword exists for the season.

MISMATCHED_STARTGIFT.subject: STARTGIFT
MISMATCHED_STARTGIFT.rule: Every start gift is in its keyword's pool.

DUPLICATE_STARTGIFT.subject: STARTGIFT
DUPLICATE_STARTGIFT.rule: No start gift repeats, reported once per repeat.

INSUFFICIENT_FLOORS.subject: FLOORS
INSUFFICIENT_FLOORS.rule: A published planner has every floor its category lays out.

MISSING_THEMEPACK.subject: THEMEPACK
MISSING_THEMEPACK.rule: Every floor of a published planner has a theme pack.

DUPLICATE_THEMEPACK.subject: THEMEPACK
DUPLICATE_THEMEPACK.rule: No theme pack repeats across floors.

OUT_OF_ORDER_THEMEPACK.subject: THEMEPACK
OUT_OF_ORDER_THEMEPACK.rule: A floor has a theme pack only when the floor before it has one.

OUT_OF_ORDER_DIFFICULTY.subject: DIFFICULTY
OUT_OF_ORDER_DIFFICULTY.rule: No Normal floor follows the first Hard floor.

OUT_OF_RANGE_DIFFICULTY.subject: DIFFICULTY
OUT_OF_RANGE_DIFFICULTY.rule: A floor of the shortest category is Normal or Hard.

INSUFFICIENT_DIFFICULTY_ENTRY.subject: DIFFICULTY
INSUFFICIENT_DIFFICULTY_ENTRY.rule: The floors a longer category shares with the shortest one are Hard, which opens the floors after them.

OUT_OF_RANGE_DIFFICULTY_NOT_HARD.subject: DIFFICULTY
OUT_OF_RANGE_DIFFICULTY_NOT_HARD.rule: Floors six to ten are Hard only.

OUT_OF_RANGE_DIFFICULTY_NOT_EXTREME.subject: DIFFICULTY
OUT_OF_RANGE_DIFFICULTY_NOT_EXTREME.rule: Floors eleven to fifteen are Extreme only.

UNKNOWN_THEMEPACK.subject: THEMEPACK
UNKNOWN_THEMEPACK.rule: A floor's theme pack id exists in the game data.

UNKNOWN_EGOGIFT_FLOOR.subject: EGOGIFT
UNKNOWN_EGOGIFT_FLOOR.rule: Every floor E.G.O gift id exists in the game data.

UNAFFORDABLE_EGOGIFT.subject: EGOGIFT
UNAFFORDABLE_EGOGIFT.rule: Every floor E.G.O gift is obtainable in that floor's theme pack.
